book.name: MATEO
book.title: SAN MATEO Maach peerdʉ aaujem Jesucristo igwia jöoi Mateoou phã pʉatarr

content: Juan chi õor pör choomie thõotarr
Mag Jesús nem khĩir pogkhe õor dakhĩir wau nʉrrʉm jaar ĩchab Erodeta Galilea durr reikha sĩejim. Mag ag na õrau nem ooba aajempa ich Jesuu wau sim sĩi bĩi wëjöm chi Erodeeu ũr athaawai
ich dʉ̈i ãbam degam khʉʉnag, —Maan Juan chi õor pör choomie khararrta deeu iiu phiidʉwia mag nʉrrʉmgui ajim anʉm; maguata mag õor mor masim khʉʉnpa monaau nʉrrabahab ajim anaabá.

Irua mag sĩerran mʉga ajim aajem: Maata ich Erodeeu ich naam Felipe ʉʉi Erodías anʉmta khecheu auwi sĩejim anaabá. Mag atheeta Juanau chi reíg, “Pua pöd pʉch naam ʉʉi khecheu auwi pʉch ʉʉikha auju khaba simgui” ajim anʉm. Mamʉ sĩi ichig magbaawai warag Juan pʉr aupi jaauwi, cárcel deg phãar sĩupinaa cadenau jʉ̈ sĩupijim anaabá.

Ichig mag iekhatarr aawaita chi Erodeeu i thõopʉ̈im iigjeejim anʉm. Mamʉ thumaam khʉʉnau Juanau Ẽwandam iekta jaau sim khaphʉ narr aawai, irua thõopʉ̈ikhiin, jũrr õrau ichta khaigbaju a khĩirjuwia pöd thõoba aajeejim aajem.
Mamʉ mag nʉm ee, biek ãb chi Erodes año cumpliitarr ag phiesta kha nʉm ee chi Erodías kha jemkhajim aajem, õor khapan thʉnʉm na. Mag i jemkha sim oowia, ich Erodeeu khõchkha thʉnʉisiwi,
ich bãaurrag, “Pʉchdëu nem khõsim mʉrʉg jëeubá; mʉch imeerba mua deeb khaba deejugui” ajim anaabá.

Mamʉ magbarm chi ãdaujã ũrtarr aawai ich chaai wawí sĩujim anʉm. Magbaawai chi chaairau ich bãaurr jöoyag, “Magan mʉ athee Juan chi õor pör choomie pörta thëp ee audeebá; jãata mua khõsi ʉmgui” ajim anʉm.
Mamʉ mag Juan pörta ichig jëeubaawai warre chi rey ökhĩirjuu aadëjim anaabá. Mamʉ ichdëu õor thʉ̈rkhʉʉitarr dʉ̈i ãbam mes gaai nʉmuata mag ichig jëeubarm nem deeju a iekhatarr aawai
chadcha Juan cárcel deg sĩerr aar õor pʉ̈iwia thõonaa, chi pör appai thëp ee waibëepi jaaujim anaabá.
Magbaawai i ipierr wëtwi, chadcha ichdëu jaautarrjö thõonaa, chi pör thʉapnaa aibëewi, chi daupeer mag chi jemkha sĩerrag deechëjierram aajem. Magbaa ichdëu jũrr ich ãdag deejim anaabá.
Mag chi Juan ö thʉapbapʉ̈im abaawai, i dʉ̈i wënʉrraajerr khʉʉndamau bëewi, arrwi, aukhërjierram anaabá. Maimua ya mag amau i thõobapäaiwaita maar aig Jesuug jawaan bëejierram.
Jesuu õor cinco mil jãogtarr

Mag Juan ö thʉap thõobarm ich aar jaaubaimam ũrwia, ökhĩirjugau warag chawag õor chukag aar maju abaawai, marau i joo arrjim. Pari mag wëtumua ya maar döjãrr paaukhabaadëm õrau oopʉ̈itarr aawai ag dakha phöbör nʉnʉidʉm eem khʉʉnau jũrr khʉd garmua maar na ërëubaadëjim.
Maimua ya jopimawia ooimaawai i na õor pöoma thʉnaajim. Magbaawai am dau aug khaugwi am aaunaanjã monaaupʉ̈imajim.
Mag nʉm ee, ya kheeuraa aadeewai maach garmuata irig, —Mʉg õorjã chukag eeta ya kheeuraa aadëm; amag wëtpi jaaubá, phöbör ee wëtwi amach athee khöjudam për aumkhĩir anaajim.
Magbaawai, —Khöju jʉraanpai chan am wëtju khaba nʉm. ¿Jãg pãachdëuta am jãogbamma? ajim, ich Jesuu maachigta.
Magbaawai marau, —Maar khöju chukhu nʉmgui ajim amag deeg. Ãba pandamta cinco wai nʉm dʉ̈i ãwarrdamta dau numpai wai nʉm ajim irig.
Magbaawaita ichdëu, —Makhʉʉndam mʉ aig aipidut ajim.

Mag chadcha ich aig aipierrwai õor pöm mag thʉnarrag, —Phũak ee ohood abat ajim. Maimua mag pandam cinco narr dʉ̈i chi ãwarrdampa phë auwia ʉ̈gthaag eerpanaa, Ẽwandamag ag paar ʉ̈u ajim anaa, ichdëupai chi pan thorreunaa marag ʉapʉ̈imajim. Magbaawai jũrr maachdëuta õrag jigmajim.

Mag jigmamua, jigmamua, ich iiu aawai thumaam khʉʉnau amachdëu khöm aig khötarrjã dʉ̈rr apiwi, pan pöm sobjim, chi ãwarrjã agjö. Mag chi sobtarr phë aunaa oowai thʉbʉt khapan docen ãb öbërjim chi ipiirkham.
Mag ed mag Jesuu jãogtarr khʉʉn chi khapanag cinco mil naajim, emkhooin appai, ʉʉin beerba ni chaainjã beerba.
Jesús döjã ʉ̈r nʉrrarr
Mag õor pöm thach khöpiwi jũrr maachta ich na maach dʉrbagkhatarr jap ee wëtpi jaaujim, ich na thoom igar naaimamkhĩir. Maagwai ichin agtha ich aig sĩsijim õor oopäaiwai.
Maimua õor thum ërëuwia ich appai aadeewaita, i iek buchag gaai ich appai ich Ayag jëwaan majim aajem. Maagwai ya edau khëubaadeewaijã mam ich appai chirajim aajem.
Magʉmich maran ya döjãrr naajim. Mamʉ maar khĩir garmuata phũ wë thʉnarr aawai maar japan phũasau öpphërta jiir ahau khajim.
Maimua ya ãspa urumuata ich Jesús maar ẽudee bëejim. Pari mag urumjã sĩi döjã ʉ̈rta jẽb thetag gayamjö urajim.
Mag döjã ʉ̈rta jẽb gayamjö maachig urum oobaawai jãphierrwi maar ääi khaphöbaadëjim. Mag jãphierrnaa ääikhamua, —Keena, akhaar khabahaba anaajim marau.
Pari magbaawai ich Jesuu, —Keena, oob jãphierrmiet; mʉ khabahab ajim marag.
Magbaa Pedroou irig, —Señor, chadcha pʉchta Jesús khai, magan mʉjã pʉchjö döjã ʉ̈r pʉch aar mapibá ajim.
Magbaawai irig, —Bëejuma ajim Jesuu. Magbaawai chadcha Pedroou jap eemua waaidʉbaadëwi Jesús khĩirphee dʉdʉrgmaa ajim, döjã ʉ̈rta durramjö.
Pari phũas dau dapag oowi jãphierrbaadëjim. Mag jãphierrbaadëm ee ĩchab ya ierrpamajim. Magbaawaita maach Pörög, —Señor, mʉ oobahur, mʉʉn ierrpamamgui ajim.
Magbarm bʉ̈rre Jesuu i jua gaai pʉrnaa, —¿Khanthee pua pʉch ierrpaju khĩirjujĩ? Jãgan pua chan mua pʉchig nem mag aawaijã mʉ iek ʉ̈khaba chirabma ajim irig.
Maimua ya am jap ee waaidʉtkhabaadee chi phũ meuu aadëjim.
Mag chi Jesús jap ee pabaadee i khĩirphee kanieu phõbkhanaa, —Chadcha pʉʉta Ẽwandam Iewaau anaajim, marau irig.
Genesaretpien Jesuu monaaukhatarr
Mag wëtumua thoom igar Genesaret durr phẽeubaimajierram.
Mag Jesús barbaimam õrau khaugphöbaadee, sĩi ag perás bĩi jöisijim. Mag amachdëu khaugphöbaadee i aig õor mor masim khʉʉn aibëenaa irig,
—Maar aaunaanag pʉch khajũahidam gaaipai khãijã pʉrpibá aajeejim, monaaumkhĩir. Mag chadcha thum i khajũa gaai pʉrmam khʉʉnan warre monaaukha maajeejim, mag sĩi pʉrbarmuapai.
